transform_embedding_request: transform an OpenAI embedding request to GigaChat API format with model and input normalization
transform_embedding_response: transform a GigaChat embedding response to OpenAI-compatible format with usage token aggregation
validate_environment: validate the GigaChat embedding environment by setting up OAuth Bearer token headers
get_complete_url: get the complete GigaChat embeddings endpoint URL from a configurable base URL
get_error_class: get the GigaChatEmbeddingError class instance for a given error message and status code
